title: Peruvian Sweet Potato Fritters with Garlic Aioli
description: A delicious Peruvian-inspired dish featuring crispy sweet potato fritters served with a creamy garlic aioli. Perfect as a snack or side dish.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
2. Boil the sweet potatoes until tender, then mash.
3. In a bowl, mix together the cornmeal, flour, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
4. Add the mashed sweet potatoes, egg, and garlic to the bowl and mix well.
5. Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
6. Fry the fritters in the hot oil for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
7. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
8. For the garlic aioli, mix together minced garlic and mayonnaise in a bowl.
9. Serve the fritters hot with the garlic aioli for dipping.
